high_level_description: This image is an animated scene featuring two characters from the "Dragon Ball" series. The setting appears to be a mountainous landscape with snow-covered peaks and rugged terrain. The sky is a soft pinkish hue, suggesting either dawn or dusk. The two characters are sitting on a rock in the foreground. Both are wearing traditional martial arts attire, consisting of orange pants, blue boots, and blue arm bands. The character on the left has spiky black hair and is looking down with a somewhat distressed expression, while the character on the right has a more neutral or slightly concerned look.
